title: Escape brackets and backslash in httptools HEADER_RE regex
description:
The `HEADER_RE` regex used for header name validation in `httptools_impl.py` has a broken character class:

```python
HEADER_RE = re.compile(b'[\x00-\x1f\x7f()<>@,;:[]={} \t\\"]')
```

The `]` after `:` is unescaped, which prematurely closes the character class. After Python string processing, the regex engine sees:
- Character class: `[\x00-\x1f\x7f()<>@,;:[]` (closes at first unescaped `]`)  
- Followed by literal sequence: `={} \t\"` then `]`

This means the regex effectively never matches because the literal sequence after the class requires those exact bytes in order. I tested it — the old regex fails to detect **every** invalid header name character including control bytes, spaces, brackets, equals, braces, quotes, and backslashes.

Fixed by properly escaping `[`, `]`, and `\` inside the character class:

```python
HEADER_RE = re.compile(b'[\x00-\x1f\x7f()<>@,;:\\[\\]={} \t\\\\"]')
```

Quick test showing the difference:
```
b'bad header'    old=False  new=True
b'bad[header'    old=False  new=True
b'bad]header'    old=False  new=True
b'bad=header'    old=False  new=True
b'\x00h'         old=False  new=True
b'"bad"'         old=False  new=True
```

diff --git a/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py b/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py
index 0c9c20f1c..d6c976222 100644
--- a/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py
+++ b/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py
@@ -27,7 +27,7 @@
 from uvicorn.protocols.utils import get_client_addr, get_local_addr, get_path_with_query_string, get_remote_addr, is_ssl
 from uvicorn.server import ServerState
 
-HEADER_RE = re.compile(b'[\x00-\x1f\x7f()<>@,;:[]={} \t\\"]')
+HEADER_RE = re.compile(b'[\x00-\x1f\x7f()<>@,;:\\[\\]={} \t\\\\"]')
 HEADER_VALUE_RE = re.compile(b"[\x00-\x08\x0a-\x1f\x7f]")
